event.title: Public Money? Public Code! – Online talk at Bits&Bäume Mainz/Rhein-Main (online)

body.p: Public Money? Public Code! – Online talk at Bits&Bäume Mainz/Rhein-Main

On 4 November 2026, from 10:00 to 11:30 CET, Bits&Bäume Mainz/Rhein-Main will host an online event on “Public Money? Public Code!”. Johannes Näder, FSFE Policy Programme Manager, will present the FSFE’s “Public Money? Public Code!” initiative and discuss current opportunities and challenges for Free Software in public administrations and for digital infrastructures that can be controlled and shaped by those who use them.

The participants will then discuss the topic with a focus on Rhineland-Palatinate and Hesse and explore ways to contribute to digitalisation for the common good in their personal and professional lives. The event series draws on the political demands of the Bits&Bäume alliance:
https://bits-und-baeume.org/posts/forderungen-bundestagswahl-2025-html/

The event will be held in German via BigBlueButton:
https://collaboratorum.agl-einewelt.de/bbb/bit-nlf-kfy-4ri/
